concepts.name: Number Sense
concepts.subject: mathematics
concepts.description: Understanding of integers, fractions, decimals, and basic arithmetic operations.
learning_objectives: Perform and reason about basic arithmetic operations accurately.

concepts.name: Variables and Expressions
concepts.subject: mathematics
concepts.description: Using symbols to represent unknown quantities and combining them into expressions.
learning_objectives: Translate word problems into algebraic expressions.

concepts.name: Linear Equations
concepts.subject: mathematics
concepts.description: Solving equations of the form ax + b = c and their graphical interpretation.
learning_objectives: Solve single-variable linear equations and interpret their solutions.

concepts.name: Inequalities
concepts.subject: mathematics
concepts.description: Solving and graphing linear inequalities and compound inequalities.
learning_objectives: Solve and graph linear inequalities on a number line.

concepts.name: Functions
concepts.subject: mathematics
concepts.description: The concept of a function as a mapping from inputs to outputs, including domain and range.
learning_objectives: Determine whether a relation is a function and identify its domain and range.

concepts.name: Systems of Equations
concepts.subject: mathematics
concepts.description: Solving two or more linear equations simultaneously using substitution and elimination.
learning_objectives: Solve systems of linear equations using multiple methods.

concepts.name: Exponents and Logarithms
concepts.subject: mathematics
concepts.description: Rules of exponents and their inverse relationship with logarithms.
learning_objectives: Simplify exponential expressions and solve basic logarithmic equations.

concepts.name: Polynomials
concepts.subject: mathematics
concepts.description: Operations on polynomial expressions including factoring and the remainder theorem.
learning_objectives: Factor polynomials and apply the remainder and factor theorems.

concepts.name: Quadratic Equations
concepts.subject: mathematics
concepts.description: Solving quadratic equations via factoring, completing the square, and the quadratic formula.
learning_objectives: Solve quadratic equations using at least two distinct methods.

concepts.name: Euclidean Geometry Basics
concepts.subject: mathematics
concepts.description: Points, lines, angles, triangles, and basic geometric proofs.
learning_objectives: Apply basic geometric theorems to solve for unknown angles and lengths.

concepts.name: Coordinate Geometry
concepts.subject: mathematics
concepts.description: Representing geometric objects in the Cartesian plane, distance and midpoint formulas.
learning_objectives: Compute distances, midpoints, and slopes between points on the coordinate plane.

concepts.name: Trigonometry Basics
concepts.subject: mathematics
concepts.description: Right-triangle trigonometry: sine, cosine, tangent, and their applications.
learning_objectives: Apply sine, cosine, and tangent to solve right-triangle problems.

concepts.name: Trigonometric Functions
concepts.subject: mathematics
concepts.description: Extending trigonometry to the unit circle, periodic functions, and radian measure.
learning_objectives: Graph and interpret trigonometric functions over the unit circle.

concepts.name: Sequences and Series
concepts.subject: mathematics
concepts.description: Arithmetic and geometric sequences, summation notation, and convergence.
learning_objectives: Derive and apply formulas for the nth term and sum of arithmetic and geometric sequences.

concepts.name: Complex Numbers
concepts.subject: mathematics
concepts.description: Representing and operating on numbers with real and imaginary parts.
learning_objectives: Perform arithmetic on complex numbers and represent them geometrically.

concepts.name: Rational Functions
concepts.subject: mathematics
concepts.description: Functions expressed as ratios of polynomials, including asymptotic behavior.
learning_objectives: Identify asymptotes and discontinuities of rational functions.

concepts.name: Limits
concepts.subject: mathematics
concepts.description: The behavior of a function as its input approaches a particular value.
learning_objectives: Evaluate limits algebraically, graphically, and numerically.

concepts.name: Continuity
concepts.subject: mathematics
concepts.description: Formal definition of continuity and classification of discontinuities.
learning_objectives: Determine whether a function is continuous at a point using the limit definition.

concepts.name: Derivatives
concepts.subject: mathematics
concepts.description: The instantaneous rate of change of a function, defined as the limit of a difference quotient.
learning_objectives: Compute derivatives from the limit definition for simple functions.

concepts.name: Differentiation Rules
concepts.subject: mathematics
concepts.description: Power, product, quotient, and chain rules for computing derivatives efficiently.
learning_objectives: Apply differentiation rules to compute derivatives of composite functions.

concepts.name: Applications of Derivatives
concepts.subject: mathematics
concepts.description: Using derivatives for optimization, related rates, and curve sketching.
learning_objectives: Use derivatives to solve real-world optimization and related-rates problems.

concepts.name: Integrals
concepts.subject: mathematics
concepts.description: The antiderivative and the accumulation of quantities via Riemann sums.
learning_objectives: Compute basic antiderivatives and approximate area under a curve.

concepts.name: Fundamental Theorem of Calculus
concepts.subject: mathematics
concepts.description: The formal link between differentiation and integration.
learning_objectives: State and apply the fundamental theorem of calculus to evaluate definite integrals.

concepts.name: Integration Techniques
concepts.subject: mathematics
concepts.description: Substitution, integration by parts, and partial fractions.
learning_objectives: Select and apply an appropriate integration technique for a given integral.

concepts.name: Introduction to Differential Equations
concepts.subject: mathematics
concepts.description: Basic first-order differential equations and separable equations.
learning_objectives: Solve simple separable first-order differential equations.

concepts.name: Vectors
concepts.subject: mathematics
concepts.description: Vector representation, magnitude, direction, and basic vector operations.
learning_objectives: Perform vector addition, scalar multiplication, and compute dot products.

concepts.name: Matrices
concepts.subject: mathematics
concepts.description: Matrix representation, operations, and their use in representing linear systems.
learning_objectives: Perform matrix addition, multiplication, and represent a linear system in matrix form.

concepts.name: Determinants
concepts.subject: mathematics
concepts.description: Computing determinants and their geometric and algebraic significance.
learning_objectives: Compute determinants of 2x2 and 3x3 matrices and interpret their meaning.

concepts.name: Linear Systems in Matrix Form
concepts.subject: mathematics
concepts.description: Solving systems of linear equations using matrix methods such as Gaussian elimination.
learning_objectives: Solve linear systems using Gaussian elimination in matrix form.

concepts.name: Eigenvalues and Eigenvectors
concepts.subject: mathematics
concepts.description: Finding eigenvalues and eigenvectors and their significance for linear transformations.
learning_objectives: Compute eigenvalues and eigenvectors of a small square matrix.

concepts.name: Vector Spaces
concepts.subject: mathematics
concepts.description: Abstract vector spaces, basis, dimension, and linear independence.
learning_objectives: Determine whether a set of vectors forms a basis for a given vector space.

concepts.name: Probability Basics
concepts.subject: mathematics
concepts.description: Fundamental probability concepts: sample spaces, events, and basic probability rules.
learning_objectives: Compute probabilities of simple and compound events.

concepts.name: Combinatorics
concepts.subject: mathematics
concepts.description: Counting techniques including permutations and combinations.
learning_objectives: Apply permutation and combination formulas to solve counting problems.

concepts.name: Descriptive Statistics
concepts.subject: mathematics
concepts.description: Measures of central tendency and spread: mean, median, mode, variance, standard deviation.
learning_objectives: Compute and interpret measures of central tendency and spread for a dataset.

concepts.name: Probability Distributions
concepts.subject: mathematics
concepts.description: Discrete and continuous probability distributions including binomial and normal distributions.
learning_objectives: Apply the binomial and normal distributions to compute probabilities.
